newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium extends swine fever cull.
newsitem.headline: Belgium extends swine fever cull.

text.p: Belgium is extending the cull of pigs started earlier this month to four more farms following the discovery of swine fever.

The Agriculture Ministry said in a statement on Tuesday a total of 1,112 animals would be slaughtered to add to the approximately 56,500 already killed since the first cases of the disease were discovered at the end of June.
Belgium has around seven million pigs.
The new measures bring the number of farms affected by the preventative cull to 55, the ministry said.

Swine fever has spread throughout Europe this year, badly affecting farms in Germany, the Netherlands and Spain. In the Netherlands, nearly five million pigs, or 40 percent of the national herd, have been slaughtered to stop it spreading.
